# Prisoner Standard Operating Procedure
This procedure applies to all [bold]permanent prisoners[/bold].
## Escape Roleplay
On [bold]Code Blue[/bold] or any higher alert, prisoners are [bold]not[/bold] allowed to attempt escape roleplay. The only exceptions are:
- You are being mistreated. - You have rolled an antagonist justifying escaping. - You are being helped to escape by antagonists.
On [bold]Code Green[/bold], you [italic]may[/italic] attempt escape roleplay, but only if there are enough security forces on shift to handle it. If security is thin, an escape becomes a heavy strain on the few people available and on crew who would rather not deal with it.
Keep it fun for everyone, including the people who have to come and get you.
[italic]For alert levels, see [textlink="Alert Procedure" link="GuideAlertProcedure"]. For your rights while confined, see [textlink="Brigging SOP" link="GuideBriggingSOP"].[/italic]
